assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: cinematic widescreen background for an explosive fantasy MMORPG launch campaign MU PANIC, landscape 16:9. Primary request: premium AAA dark fantasy launch key art, a ferocious battle erupting on a ruined fortress bridge over a volcanic abyss. Dynamic low camera, sharp original characters: on left a massive ornate black and gold armored blade knight with huge crimson feathered wings slashing a flaming greatsword; on right an elegant silver-armored elven archer with blue luminous wings drawing a radiant bow, and a dark sorcerer behind her casting violet lightning. Warriors framed mainly on left and right thirds, a distant colossal horned armored boss at center upper distance, exploding rock debris, violent magical trails, cinematic smoke, embers and ash, hot orange lava against violet lightning, strong rim lighting, detailed metallic armor, visceral scale, extraordinary motion and depth. Composition: heroes at edges frame a darker open smoky center for website typography overlay, center is dark enough to read large white and gold text. Full bleed horizontal poster, impeccable polished cinematic 3D concept art, recognizable classic Korean fantasy MMORPG visual flavor with original character designs. NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO watermark, NO UI, NO panels, NO circles or portals, no generic lone castle landscape. This is an action battle scene, not a calm landscape. High resolution.

Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: portrait 9:16 epic fantasy MMORPG launch mobile website background for MU PANIC. Create a vertical full-bleed AAA cinematic battle poster. A menacing original black and gold armored blade knight with crimson wings occupies upper LEFT third, an original silver-armored elven archer with icy luminous blue wings occupies upper RIGHT third, facing diagonally inward in battle. Upper two fifths are dramatic close-up characters with energy swords, bow and violet lightning. A horned demon fortress boss looms in distant upper center. Flaming ruined fortress and falling rock debris behind them. LOWER two thirds must stay dark smoky purple-charcoal and volcanic atmosphere with low-contrast embers, intentionally clean for overlaid giant website title and countdown: do not put main characters or important detail behind center/lower typography. Dramatic fire orange on left versus magic violet-blue on right; gorgeous detailed original metallic armor, spectacular cinematic lighting, high fidelity painterly 3D action concept art. Hero image only. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no frames or cards. Original fantasy characters, classic Korean dark fantasy MMORPG flavor. Tall portrait composition.

Use case: lighting-weather / precise faithful image enhancement. Edit target: attached real MU PANIC client server selection screenshot. Improve the visual quality of THIS exact image for a premium launch website presentation: clearer detailed armor and rocky textures, cleaner edges, reduced compression softness, refined atmospheric lighting and subtle richer red/gold contrast. Preserve the complete screenshot composition, all actual interface components, exact scene and placement, top MU PANIC logo, warrior at left, red crystal at right, center server-selection panel, bottom Menu button. Do not invent, replace or move any UI, do not add game elements, do not redesign the game interface. ALL existing interface text must remain unchanged, including 'MU PANIC', 'SELECCIONA TU SERVIDOR', 'MU PANIC-1(Gold) Conectar', 'BIENVENIDO A MU PANIC', 'MENÚ'. Preserve widescreen 16:9 aspect and entire frame. Keep it recognizable as the same real client screenshot, simply clean and crisp. No new watermark, no new captions, no new logos, no decorative frame. No gratuitous oversharpening or artificial glowing edges. Output the enhanced image at high resolution.

Create an original from scratch ultra epic cinematic dark fantasy MMORPG battle key art, widescreen 16:9, matching a premium MU Online Season 6 inspired launch campaign with crimson fire, gold metal and violet magic. A colossal serpent queen MEDUSA as the epic boss dominates the central-right composition: terrifying regal woman with a many-serpent crown, obsidian and antique gold armor, enormous black wings, serpentine lower body winding through a shattered fortress battlefield, glowing emerald eyes, staff of twisting golden serpents. She unleashes an explosive emerald and violet storm at a heroic raid party in the foreground: a crimson winged armored knight with a burning greatsword, elegant silver-armored elven archer firing electric blue arrows, dark wizard channeling spectacular purple magic. Truly monumental boss scale, believable detailed anatomy, dynamic attack poses, radial magical shockwave, rubble suspended in air, emerald venom rivers, ember rain, ruined cathedral towers, apocalyptic storm clouds and orange fire horizon. Vivid cinematic high contrast, exquisite material detail, volumetric lighting, sophisticated AAA game poster quality, action and character silhouettes instantly readable. Boss face and crown in upper right, party in lower center, keep upper left third relatively dark for huge website title overlay. Design a completely original new composition. No typography, words, letters, logos, UI, healthbars or watermarks.

assets.prompt: Edit this reference into a precise transparent VFX overlay asset for the SAME widescreen website image. Retain ONLY the brilliant emerald green lightning and branching venom energy around Medusa's outstretched hand at x49% y36% and down across the lower central battlefield, and vivid violet branching lightning around the wizard at lower-right x85% y82% connecting up toward center x55% y45%. Remove ALL people, boss, clothing, architecture, ground, background and solid objects completely; all other pixels must be transparent. Keep the energy in the exact original composition and positions in the same full 1672x941 16:9 canvas so this image can be placed directly on top of the reference. Intensify these existing jagged lightning filaments dramatically into dazzling white-hot cores with saturated emerald and violet luminous fringes, long intricate forked arcs and isolated sparks. Crisp premium cinematic electric spell effects, irregular branching organic lightning, no circles, no rings, no portals, no circular outlines. Do not include any text or UI. Transparent background is mandatory. The effect itself should be bold, dazzling and highly visible, yet most of the canvas remains transparent.
